examples.pie: déh₃tis gʷr̥Htéh₂ h₁ésti. dh₃tóm néḱt. ń̥dʰgʷʰitom ḱléwos dh₃tréy h₁ésti. h₁yós gʷṓs h₂lékseti gʷówes tósmey pléh₁dʰonti. moysóns sélos mē wédʰes. pótis moysóns bʰérǵʰom wédʰeti.
examples.en: Giving is praised. What is given is not lost. The giver has imperishable fame. To him who guards cattle, the cattle increase. Do not lead the sheep to the marsh. The master leads the sheep to the hill.

pie-lex-memoghe.gloss: to have power, to be able to; can, may
senses: to have power, to be able to

examples.pie: nu dʰénwr̥ mē Hrumpih₁tó memgʰih₁mé-kʷe.
examples.en: Now may the bow not break, and may we be able!

examples.pie: h₁yós memógʰe tl̥néh₂eti só tód.
examples.en: Whoever is able shall lift it.

examples.pie: h₁yós memógʰe só wr̥ǵyéti.
examples.en: He who is able, works.

examples.pie: h₁sónt ḱuh₁róm ne-kʷe mért dʰrówgʰos ml̥dús. h₁yós dʰrugʰyéti só bʰéh₂esos bʰebʰóyh₂e. dʰrówgʰosyo pódh₁e mr̥ǵʰúh₁.
examples.en: The truth is strong, and it does not die; the lie is weak. He who deceives fears the light. The feet of a lie are short.

examples.pie: stnéh₂t táwros dréwi Hn̥dʰí nu h₂éwis tósmi sédt mléwHt-kʷe. táwre me dedórḱth₂e? h₂epó léytoh₂? ne te dedórḱh₂e. ne te h₂wéysm̥ mē-kʷe h₂wéysoh₂. tewh₂sós ml̥dúm ne widét.
examples.en: An aurochs stood under a tree. A bird sat down on him and said: "Aurochs, do you see me? Shall I go away?" "I do not see you. I did not hear you, and I will not hear you." The strong does not notice the weak.

examples.pie: kʷíd ph₂ter ne h₁ḗdsi? dʰúgh₂ter moy h₃dóntes lelikʷḗr. mḗms moy dʰr̥ǵʰtóm. nu toy ml̥dúm mā́dsom h₃n̥gʷénh₁ h₂réydʰōh₂. túH h₁uséwih₂ dʰugh₂tḗr. bʰréh₂teres toy h₂ḱh₃ént? h₂ḱh₃ént h₂éǵrom-kʷe gʷh₂ént.
examples.en: Father, why do you not eat? My teeth are gone, daughter. The meat is hard for me. Then I will prepare soft mush with butter for you. You are a good daughter. Did your brothers eat? They ate, and they went to the field.

examples.pie: nu h₂usési déh₂newi yéh₂t ḱóymosyo-kʷe dʰuh₂móm spéḱyet. sékʷt. dʰuh₂mós. nu swóm ḱḗr méwdt.
examples.en: At dawn he went along the river and looked at the smoke of the village. He said: "Smoke!" And his own heart was glad.

examples.pie: méh₂tr̥s ḱḗr ne dʰrugʰyéti. méh₂tēr swóm suHnúm wóyde. téḱnom kʷid swéh₂s méh₂tr̥s ne kéwdʰeti.
examples.en: A mother's heart does not deceive. The mother knows her son. The child hides nothing from his mother.

examples.pie: h₂wést. kʷyéh₁s? kʷyéh₁m̥ ḱḗr-kʷe moy méwdeti. nu swóns h₁éḱwons dṓm h₁élh₂oh₂. m̥néh₁ye h₁ddʰí-kʷe.
examples.en: It has dawned. Did you rest? I rested, and my heart is glad. Now I will drive my horses home. Stay and eat!

examples.pie: h₁yós sewyóm ǵʰh₂n̥sés péth₂r̥ Hrunépeti trésetu só.
examples.en: Whoever breaks the left wing of a goose, let him tremble.

examples.pie: suHnús tósyeh₂ey ǵenh₁ós h₁ést séh₂-kʷe tréset.
examples.en: A son was born to her, and she trembled with fear.

examples.pie: só h₁ludʰét widéh₁yet-kʷe tā́m. séh₂ tréset.
examples.en: He arrived and saw her. She trembled in fear.

examples.pie: kʷíd ḱósyo h₁nómn̥? séh₂ toy gʰébʰestis. kʷíd ḱód? só toy h₂erHmós. kʷíd ḱód? h₂yúHn̥ḱe toy só ǵʰédos. gʰébʰestis h₂erHmós ǵʰédos-kʷe. tríh₂ wékʷesh₂ h₁éwks.
examples.en: What is the name of this? That is your hand. What is this? That is your shoulder. What is this? That is your butt, young one! Hand, shoulder and butt! You have learned three words.

examples.pie: ǵénh₁tri moy h₂wl̥péys spélom wéwke. h₂wĺ̥pis ḱóymom nékʷti gʷémt. h₂ówins widét. nu kʷíd dʰéh₁t? h₁íh₂n̥s gʷr̥h₃ét. nu l̥gʰdʰí. h₂wl̥péys dedwóyh₂e. mē bʰéyh₂s. h₂wĺ̥pis medtéh₂.
examples.en: Mother, tell me a story about the fox. The fox came to the village at night. She saw the sheep. What did she do then? She devoured them. Now lie down. I am afraid of the fox. Do not be afraid. The fox is full.

examples.pie: h₂wĺ̥pis spérm̥ h₁épt. spḗr h₂éǵt. h₂wĺ̥pey deywóns gʷr̥nHdʰí nu-kʷe me h₁ddʰí. h₂wĺ̥pis h₁íns gʷr̥néHt. spḗr h₁ésyeh₂s sth₃méns bʰéwgt. nu h₂wĺ̥pis mléwHt. h₁íns h₂ew ne gʷr̥néHoh₂.
examples.en: The fox seized a sparrow. The sparrow said: "Fox, praise the gods, and then eat me!" The fox praised them. And the sparrow fled from her mouth. Then the fox said: "I will not praise them again."

examples.pie: h₁regʷesyéti. kúdʰe sésoh₂? légʰos toy h₂Hséh₂i dʰéh₁m̥. l̥gʰdʰí kʷih₁dʰí-kʷe. gʰóstipotey toy swépnos sweh₂dús h₁syéh₁t.
examples.en: It is getting dark. Where shall I sleep? I have put a bed for you at the hearth. Lie down and rest. Host, may sleep be sweet to you!

examples.pie: sméymn̥ moy wr̥h₁dʰí. ḱwṓ nos moy h₂éwh₂osyo légʰesi dʰǵʰyés légʰt. nu moy h₂éwh₂os ḱwéni légʰt. smḗymi. ǵérh₂onts ne smḗyt.
examples.en: Tell me a joke! Yesterday our dog lay down on my grandfather's bed. Then my grandfather lay down on the dog. I am laughing! The old man was not laughing.

examples.pie: méh₂ter stéwdt. dʰúgh₂ter h₂wĺ̥h₁neh₂h₁ woséyeso. kúdʰe h₂wĺ̥h₁neh₂ h₁ésti? h₁íh₂ toy légʰesi légʰeti. nu toy swesréh₁ ḱóm sédye.
examples.en: Mother, it has turned cold. Clothe yourself in wool, daughter! Where is the wool? It is lying on your bed. Then sit with your sister.

examples.pie: h₁yós mért só sóh₂wl̥ ne dedórḱe. h₁yós gʷíh₃weti só wérǵom wérǵtu. mr̥téys mē bʰéyh₂s. h₂énǵʰos steh₂rṓy gʷémt. h₁épt ligós steh₂róm. h₁yós ǵeǵónh₁e só mért.
examples.en: He who has died does not see the sun. Whoever lives, let him do the work. Do not be afraid of death. Grief comes to the old one. Illness seizes the old one. Whoever is born, dies.

examples.pie: h₁n̥gʷniwóǵʰoh₁ gʷḗm. h₁n̥gʷniwóǵʰos HeHḱús h₁ést? h₁éy HeHḱús h₁ést mówdos-kʷe méǵʰye h₁ést. ne h₁éymi kʷértroy tḱéymi.
examples.en: I came by train. Was the train swift? It was swift, and joy was mine. I do not go; I dwell in the machine.

examples.pie: h₁n̥gʷniwóǵʰoh₁ h₁idʰé h₁ludʰóm. kʷís h₁n̥gʷniwóǵʰos? h₁éy méǵh₂s kʷékʷlos. h₁éḱwōs h₁ím ne dukénti. ń̥h₁eḱwos kʷékʷlos. h₁éḱwōs moy HeHḱéwes.
examples.en: I came here on a train. What is a train? It is a great wagon. Horses do not draw it. A horseless wagon! My horses are swift.

examples.pie: h₁n̥gʷniwóǵʰoy dʰǵʰyés gʷā́m. kʷíd só? h₁éy méǵh₂s wóǵʰos h₁éḱwōs h₁ím ne dukénti. kʷís h₁ím déwkti? péh₂wr̥ h₁ím déwkti. h₁ésmi bʰebʰih₂yéh₁m̥. h₁éḱwons moy h₂éǵōh₂.
examples.en: Yesterday I went in a fire-wagon. What is that? It is a big wagon; horses do not draw it. Who draws it? Fire draws it. I would be afraid in it! I shall drive my horses.

source.name: coinage
source.note: Determinative 'fire-wagon' (h₁n̥gʷnís 'fire' + wóǵʰos 'wagon'), as early railway words (Jap. kisha 'steam car').
